resources.string: Shows that the mesh is running and how many devices are in range.
Bluetooth is off. Tap to fix.
Location is off. Tap to fix.
Direct messages that arrive while you are not looking at the conversation.
Bluetooth and location are off. Tap to fix.

NChat sends messages directly between phones over Bluetooth, with no internet and no mobile network. To do that it needs permission to find and connect to devices around you.\n\nNothing is uploaded anywhere.
Without this permission NChat cannot see other phones, so there is no one to message.\n\nIt is used only to find nearby devices and pass messages between them. Nothing leaves the mesh.
Android will not ask again, so this has to be turned on in Settings.\n\nOpen Settings, then Permissions, and allow the nearby device permissions.
NChat needs Bluetooth switched on to reach phones around you.
Android requires Location to be switched on before any app can find nearby devices over Bluetooth.\n\nNChat does not use your location, and never records where you are.

NChat needs Bluetooth switched on to reach phones around you.\n\nAndroid also requires Location to be on before any app can scan for nearby devices. NChat does not use your location, and never records where you are.
A QR code containing your public key
Read these six words aloud to check you both see the same ones. Scanning the code is the stronger check.
Pairing needs the camera to read the other phone\'s code. Nothing is recorded, and no image leaves this device.
That is not an NChat pairing code.
Check these words match the ones on their screen.
You have not verified this contact. Pair by QR code to confirm their key really belongs to them.
Messages to Everyone are not encrypted. Anyone in range can read them.
It is removed from this phone only. Anyone who already received it keeps their copy.
Only you see this name. Leave it empty to use the name they chose.
New messages in this chat are deleted from this phone after the time you pick. Messages already here stay. The other phone keeps its own copies.
Sent to every phone in range, next to your id. Leave it empty to be shown by id only.
Saved. Phones in range see it now, others the next time you meet.
Erases your identity, every message and every image on this phone. Copies on other phones are not touched.
The wipe did not run and nothing was erased. Clear the app\'s storage in Android settings instead.
Your keys, messages, images and settings are erased and cannot be recovered. Phones you paired with will see a new, unverified contact. The app closes; open it again to start fresh.
Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when Null Chat opens, or comes back after a minute away. Messages still arrive and relay while it is locked.
Needs Android 9 or later and a screen lock, set in Android settings.
Messages keep arriving and relaying while it is locked.
Anyone can pick any name. The id comes from your key, so it is what people should check, by pairing with a QR code.
